Financial Services Digital Transformation

50% Digital Performance Uplift for a Global Asset Manager

+50%
Digital performance uplift
70+
Products marketed globally
400+

The Challenge

A global asset management firm managing over 70 financial products across EU and Asia had a fundamental problem: their digital presence wasn't supporting the sales process. With 400+ sales professionals globally, the gap between marketing and sales was costing client engagement and investor conversion.

Product campaigns were built for institutional audiences but lacked the digital infrastructure to reach and engage them effectively. Sales teams had no centralised platform to access current marketing materials, product messaging or campaign content. Every market, every fund, every campaign was managed in isolation.

The firm needed a digital transformation that would bring marketing, sales enablement and client communications into a unified, scalable system — and do it across 70+ products without losing the precision that institutional investors demand.

Our Approach

01

Digital Audit & Architecture

Audited the full digital ecosystem — product pages, campaign infrastructure, sales tools and client journey touchpoints. Mapped the gaps between what marketing was producing and what sales needed.

02

Platform Design & Digital Transformation

Designed and launched a centralised digital platform giving 400+ global sales teams instant access to current product content, campaign materials and investor communications — all in one place.

03

Campaign Alignment & Performance

Rebuilt product campaign frameworks to align with the new digital infrastructure — ensuring every campaign was measurable, sales-ready and investor-appropriate from day one.

The Solution

We designed and delivered a centralised digital platform that became the single source of truth for all marketing and sales content across the firm's global operation. For the first time, 400+ sales professionals across multiple markets could access up-to-date, compliant product content instantly — without waiting for marketing.

Alongside the platform, we rebuilt the campaign architecture for the 70+ product suite — creating a scalable framework that could produce product-level campaigns efficiently while maintaining institutional-grade quality and compliance alignment.

What Was Delivered

  • ✓Centralised digital sales enablement platform
  • ✓Content architecture for 70+ financial products
  • ✓Global rollout to 400+ sales professionals
  • ✓Scalable campaign framework (EU & Asia)
  • ✓Digital client journey optimisation
  • ✓Marketing-sales alignment framework

The platform transformed how our sales teams operate. What previously required weeks of back-and-forth with marketing now happens instantly. Client engagement improved measurably, and our digital performance metrics moved by 50% within the first year.

CMO, Global Asset Management Firm

Key Takeaways

  • →Digital transformation in financial services isn't about technology — it's about enabling the people closest to clients to do their jobs better, faster and with confidence.
  • →At scale, the marketing-sales gap is the most expensive problem a firm can have. Closing it with the right platform and framework pays back immediately.
  • →70+ products don't need 70 different marketing approaches. A scalable campaign framework built on sound architecture is what makes quality consistent at volume.
